Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly classified the element "iodine" as a metal. Iodine is a halogen and is a nonmetal (though it has some metallic luster, it is chemically a nonmetal). Consequently, the Planner erroneously concluded that Option A (iodine, iron, nickel) contains only metals, failing to identify that Option C (sodium, chromium, copper) is the correct set containing exclusively metals. This represents a fundamental failure in domain-specific chemical knowledge verification.
